title: Differences in Associations of Antidepressants and Hospitalization Due to Hyponatremia
authors: Farmand S, Lindh JD, Calissendorff J, Skov J, Falhammar H, Nathanson D, et al.
population: Swedish national registers: after a 2021 corrigendum, 11,213 patients admitted with a primary diagnosis of hyponatraemia and 44,801 matched controls
funder: The cost for retrieval of the data was funded by a clinical trial investigating the effect of c-peptide for the Development of Diabetic Neuropathy sponsored by Cebix Incorporated (Grant Number: CBX12980-DN201X).
authorConflicts: Skov and Mannheimer reported personal fees from Otsuka Pharma Scandinavia AB outside the submitted work.
result: Corrected adjusted odds ratios (corrigendum, Am J Med 2021;134:554) for hospitalisation with hyponatraemia: newly initiated sertraline 6.79 (95% CI 5.02 to 9.26), citalopram 6.5, venlafaxine 6.63, escitalopram 3.02, mirtazapine 1.63, tricyclics 1.30 (0.85 to 1.96); ongoing sertraline 0.82 (0.69 to 0.97). The originally published sertraline estimate for new use was 4.96 (3.81 to 6.48). The risk is concentrated after starting treatment.
